observations: L01, L03, L06, L09, L10, L11, L12, L18, L19: long joins (ثلثـة at the end of L01; يقطَـع and وتسعـة on L03; يرجِـع at the end of L06; تمـام at the end of L09; تمـام on L10; سبعـة on L11; ايّامهـا at the end of L12; ايّامـه on L18; فهـو and تمـام on L19).

The page is twenty lines of text (L01 to L20), a rule and three lines of notes; it has no title and no signature. L01 to L19 run the full measure (L01 from 76.5 to 499.5 pt, L19 from 79.0 to 502.8 pt); L20, the short last line of the chapter, stands at the right (166.9 to 503.1 pt). The baselines stand from 127.1 to 634.0 pt down. Nallino's line numbers 5, 10, 15 and 20 stand in the left margin beside L05, L10, L15 and L20 (63.0 to 73.4 pt). The folio number «f. 151,r.» stands in the right margin beside L14 (509.0 to 539.3 pt), where the asterisk (4.3 x 5.4 pt) stands before the first فهي. Full stops stand after مستقيم on L05 and on L10, after بالتقريب on L13, after مستقيمة on L15 and at the end of L20; there is none after بالتقريب on L04, L08 and L18.

The name of each planet stands between two ornamental brackets: والمُشْتَرِي at the head of L01 (the right bracket 9.0 x 15.5 pt, the left one 8.6 x 15.1 pt), والمِرِّيخ on L05 (8.6 x 15.5 and 8.6 x 15.1 pt), والزُّهَرة on L10 (8.3 x 15.5 pt each) and والكاتب on L15 (8.6 x 15.8 and 9.0 x 15.8 pt).

Numerals in a smaller type under bars: on L04 the zero sign of the codex under its own bar ({ov:{0}}, 0; bar 13.0 pt), {ov:قكد ه} (124;5; 18.8 pt; the ه is a small ring, 2.4 x 3.0 pt) and {ov:قكز يا} (127;11; 24.5 pt); on L05 {ov:رلب مط} (232;49; 27.7 pt), then {ov:رله} (235; 13.0 pt) and {ov:نه} (55; 13.0 pt), each under its own bar; on L09 {ov:{0}} (12.0 pt), {ov:قنز لج} (157;33; 16.0 pt), {ov:قسط يد} (169;14; 24.5 pt) and {ov:قص مو} (190;46; 21.7 pt); on L10 {ov:رب كز} (202;27; 26.2 pt); on L14 {ov:{0}} (12.4 pt), {ov:قسه نج} (165;53; 21.2 pt), {ov:قسح كا} (168;21; 23.4 pt) and {ov:قصا لط} (191;39; 22.4 pt); on L15 {ov:قصد ز} (194;7; 20.4 pt); on L19 {ov:{0}} (13.0 pt), {ov:قمد م} (144;40; 17.9 pt), {ov:قمز يج} (147;13; 22.7 pt) and {ov:ريب مز} (212;47; 25.4 pt); on L20 {ov:ريه} (215; 11.5 pt) and {ov:ك} (20; 13.2 pt), each under its own bar.

The note figures: 1 after وسبعة on L02 (2.5 x 6.5 pt), 2 after وتسعون on L03 (4.0 x 6.1 pt), 3 after نه on L05 (4.0 x 6.1 pt), 4 after خمسة on L06 (4.0 x 6.1 pt), 5 after وثمانون on L08 (in two pieces, 4.3 x 4.0 and 3.2 x 1.4 pt), 6 after قنز لج on L09 (4.3 x 6.1 pt), 7 after رب كز on L10 (4.0 x 6.1 pt), 8 after اربعة on L11 (4.0 x 6.1 pt), 9 after خمسمائة on L13 (4.3 x 6.1 pt) and 10 after ك on L20 (two figures, 2.2 x 6.5 and 4.3 x 6.1 pt). The rule stands from 81.4 to 183.2 pt (101.8 pt long) at 687.4 pt down; it is broken at 127.4 to 131.8 pt. The notes are three lines (baselines 711.4, 727.9 and 743.0 pt; the first from 108.7 to 504.7 pt, the second from 81.9 to 504.7 pt, the third from 81.4 to 278.3 pt), with dashes between the notes and a dash at the end of the second line; the Arabic words of the notes have no signs; in note 6 the letters ص and س and the number 60 stand in a Latin remark in round brackets.

The two dots of the yā' stand joined under the tooth before a rā' in تدويره (L01, L03, L06, L16), تدويرها (L10, L13) and يرجِع (L02, L06, L16), and before the nūn in عشرين on L16; in مَسيره (L02, L07, L17) and مسيرها (L11) they stand free under it. In تدويره on L08 the tooth and the rā' are broken apart, with one small dot under the gap (1.4 x 1.1 pt), in both copies. In several places the tooth of the tā' of تمام stands free over the mīm (2.9 to 3.2 pt wide), with the two dots over it: the first تمام of L05, both of L14, the first of L15, the first of L19 and the second of L20.

Marks of the master scan that the second copy does not have, and that are not transcribed: a short stroke over والى before تمام قمز يج on L19 (1.1 x 1.4 pt); a short upright stroke over the wāw of واللّٰه on L20 (1.1 x 2.5 pt).

L01: والمُشْتَرِي: a damma high over the lām (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the three dots of the shīn (2.2 x 2.5 pt), a fatha over the two dots of the tā' (3.6 x 2.2 pt) and a kasra under the rā' (3.6 x 1.8 pt). يَسِير: a fatha over the first yā' (3.2 x 1.8 pt) and a kasra under the sīn (3.2 x 2.2 pt), between the dots of the two yā'. اعْلَى: a round sukun over the ʿayn (2.2 x 2.5 pt) and a fatha over the lām (3.2 x 1.8 pt); the alif has no hamza. فلك: the lām is short and broken, a thin stroke beside the fā' (0.7 x 2.9 pt), in both copies. سَبْعة: a fatha over the sīn (2.9 x 1.8 pt) and a round sukun over the bā' (2.2 x 2.5 pt). ومائة: a hamza over the tooth (2.5 x 2.9 pt). ونصفًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt). ثمّ: a shadda (3.2 x 2.5 pt). يُقيم: a damma over the yā' (2.2 x 4.0 pt). على, استقامة, من, تدويره, وثلثين, يوم and ثلثة have no signs.

L02: ايّام: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). ورُبْعًا: a damma over the rā' (2.2 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the bā' (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan (3.2 x 2.9 pt). وخُمْسًا: a damma over the dot of the khā' (2.5 x 4.7 pt), a round sukun over the mīm (2.5 x 2.5 pt) and the fathatan (3.6 x 2.9 pt). ثمّ (three times): a shadda (3.2 x 2.5, 2.9 x 1.8 and 3.6 x 2.2 pt). يرجِع: a short kasra under the jīm (2.2 x 1.4 pt), in both copies. مَسيره: a fatha over the mīm (3.6 x 2.2 pt). مائة: a hamza over the tooth (2.5 x 2.9 pt). يومًا: the fathatan (3.2 x 2.9 pt). يُقيم: a damma over the yā' (1.8 x 4.3 pt). ثانيةً: the fathatan over the two dots of the last letter (3.2 x 2.9 pt). كالمَقام: a fatha over the mīm (3.2 x 1.8 pt). الاوّل: a shadda over the wāw (3.2 x 2.2 pt); the alif has no hamza. في, يوم, وسبعة, عشر and يستقيم have no signs.

L03: الأُولَى: over the alif a hamza with a damma above it (3.6 x 6.1 pt together) and a fatha over the lām (3.6 x 2.2 pt). ايّامه: a shadda over the yā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). التي: the tā' is printed with one dot (1.8 x 1.4 pt), in both copies. يقطَع: a fatha over the ṭā' (3.2 x 2.2 pt). ثلثمائة: a hamza over the tooth (2.5 x 2.9 pt). وتسعة and وتسعون: in each word the tā' is printed as a short upright stroke without dots, standing free between the wāw and the sīn (2.2 x 5.0 and 1.8 x 4.7 pt), in both copies; the last letter of وتسعة has its two dots (3.2 x 1.8 pt). يومًا: the fathatan (3.6 x 3.2 pt). إِلّا: a hamza with a kasra under the alif (3.6 x 4.7 pt together) and a shadda high over the lām-alif (3.2 x 2.2 pt). ساعتانِ: a kasra under the last nūn (3.6 x 1.8 pt); no sign over the ʿayn. كاستقامته, فجميع, فيها, فلك and تدويره have no signs.

L04: حاصَّته: over the ṣād a shadda with a fatha above it (2.9 x 1.8 and 2.9 x 1.8 pt). المعدَّلة: over the dāl a shadda with a fatha above it (3.2 x 1.8 and 2.9 x 1.8 pt). مُقيم: a damma over the mīm (2.2 x 4.7 pt). تمام (twice): no fatha over the tā'. بالتقريب, واذا, كانت, من, الى, فهو (twice), مستقيم and والى (twice) have no signs.
